Moreover, restricting the formula to smooth functions does not make any fixed penalty coercive in H^1. On (0,1), with diffusivity 1 and reaction 0, smooth boundary layers can satisfy v_M(0)=v_M(1)=1, v'_M(0)=-M, v'_M(1)=0 and integral |v'_M|^2=O(M^-1). Then a(v_M,v_M)=-2M+2C_pen+O(M^-1)<0. Thus the asserted continuous problem and its global energy minimization are not justified.
